rule.note: parabola through the two attach points: p(t) = A + (B - A) t - up * 4 sag t (1 - t), t = 0..1; sag = max(sag_min, sag_k * L^2), L = the horizontal span; segments = max(seg_min, ceil(L / seg_len)); a tube of `sides` sides and radius r_lv (service drop, black, M_Kit_Wire) or r_bare (line wires, M_Kit_WireBare)

wires.note: v2.1: the wires are kit models - the drop Wire_Drop_1..4 (Kit_Wire_Drop, black service cable) and the line Wire_Line_1..3 (Kit_Wire_Bare) - instances in kit_instances, each turned from its socket a to b and scaled in x (scale_x); the line goes on from Pole_2 toward the base and ends at Pole_Gate: Unity places Kit_Pole about every 40 m along the road and a Kit_Wire_Bare between each pair of Wire_1..3 (onward: the ends here), or builds the spans by the rule

meta.frame: booth frame (the Checkpoint prefab's): x toward the road, y toward the back (the door, the station side), z up; origin = the middle of the pad on the ground; floor z = 0.15; the road at the barrier and the gate is 0.38 lower
meta.unity: position (x, y, z) -> Unity (-x, z, -y) in the Checkpoint prefab; axis likewise; angle -> -angle (Unity is left-handed); box centre likewise, box size (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy); a rotation R -> A R A^T, A = the axis map (rotUnity_xyzw); a scale (sx, sy, sz) -> (sx, sz, sy)
meta.roots: three roots on the map, each its own prefab, with the booth's axes in this file (yaw 0 between them): Checkpoint (the booth), Barrier (7 m out on the road), Gate (beside the booth here); and Barrier_Manual (the v1 hand barrier, a prefab not on the map, 7 m further out here). Barrier and Gate parts and sockets are given in the booth frame; map_placement: the Update 3 places (Forest_Layout.json); game_placement: where they stand in the game now (ForestRelocation moves the booth and the barrier together, ForestYardPlan leaves the gate at the yard, ~300 m away)
meta.kit: snow_kit instances (kit_instances): an empty per instance with the kit item's collection linked from ../snow_kit/snow_kit.blend; props kit_item, ix_ids (the IX_ parts of that instance get these numbers: IX_ConsoleButton -> IX_ConsoleButton_312 ...); Unity: the builder puts the item's prefab (Assets/Kit/) on the empty with its transform (the conduits are scaled in x); pos / rot / scale are in the parent's frame, pos_kpp in this file's world, pos_game in the game
meta.colliders: colliders: BoxCollider per entry on its parent: center / size in the parent's own frame (Blender), centerUnity / sizeUnity the same in Unity axes; rotation = Blender XYZ euler of the box (the roof sheet), rotationUnity = Unity euler; center_kpp: the box centre in the booth frame. part.box: the grab / hit box of a moving part in its own frame. The kit instances bring their own colliders (SNOW_KIT_CONTRACT.md)
meta.materials: M_Kpp_Kpp (the booth) / M_Kpp_KppYard (the barrier, the gate) / M_Kpp_KppProps: baked PSX atlases (point filter); M_Kpp_Panel: signs, papers, labels, the clock, the radio; M_Kpp_Lamp_Fluor / _Off, M_Kpp_Lamp_Bulk / _Off: lit / off; M_Kpp_Glow: additive halo; M_Kpp_Glass; M_Kpp_Barbed: alpha cut-out 0.5, tiled 0.5 m (Update 7's texture, one-sided). The kit instances use the kit's M_Kit_* materials
meta.prologue: S6 / X05 v2 (QUESTIONS_KPP.md «Решено»): no power at first; the players bring the van's Battery to PowerCabinet (Slot_Battery), put both clamps on, turn IX_CabinetSwitch to BATTERIE: the door lock releases IX_BoothDoor_74, the lamps light, the monitors show CAM_Barrier and CAM_Gate; Btn_Schranke raises / lowers IX_BarrierArm_82, Btn_Tor sends IX_Gate_81 along (one press, it runs to the end). The keys hang on the Key_Hook_ sockets (no Schranke), Note_KPPLog on Spot_KPPLog. X05: Phone / Phone_Receiver (zone Phone_KPP) and Phone_Bell ring
